data.narrative:
Comand AI is a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Loïc Mougeolle and Antoine Chassan that has raised €11.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning seed and Series A stages within the defense technology sector.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for current valuation ($12M), applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier to the next funding stage, implying $29M. The peer-median method triangulates across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B Series A, UFORCE at $1.0B Seed, Singularity at $400M Series A, and NODA AI at $125M Series A), yielding a median valuation of $700M with a range of $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $24M to $805M, with a median estimate of $364M. This wide dispersion reflects material stage and maturity variance within the peer set, particularly the substantial gap between seed-stage UFORCE ($1.0B) and early-stage defense AI companies. Key uncertainties include differentiation within an increasingly crowded defense AI segment and near-term revenue inflection trajectory relative to comparable companies' growth profiles.
